newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee areas cloudy and wet, but warm-Somar.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee areas cloudy and wet, but warm-Somar.

text.p: Brazil's coffee regions will see rain and clouds but no frost in the next 24 hours as a cold front moves from the north of Parana state to the south of Sao Paulo, independent meteorologist Somar said.
"This rapidly moving cold front reaches the south of Minas Gerais this evening, provoking an increase in clouds and rains of around seven mm," Somar said in a daily bulletin.
Early morning temperatures were due to remain stable at 10 to 17 degrees Celsius in the coffee regions, it added.
Numerical models indicated a change in atmospheric conditions with cold fronts translating into rains in the south-east, including coffee regions.
Somar forecast rains of 10 mm in the producing areas of southern Minas Gerais between July 23 and 24.
Maximum temperatures would drop because of the cloud cover but minimum temperatures were set to remain stable, it added.
